products.shortDescription: Board-and-card project management tool from Atlassian with built-in no-code automation, Power-Ups, extra views on Premium, and AI features on paid plans.
products.logoRightsNote: No logo used. Brand initials only.

facts.factValue: Free: $0, up to 10 collaborators per Workspace, up to 10 boards per Workspace, 10MB per file, 250 Workspace command runs per month, unlimited cards and Power-Ups.
Standard: $5 USD per user/month billed annually ($6 billed monthly). Unlimited boards, 250MB per file, 1,000 command runs per month, AI, Custom Fields.
Premium: $10 USD per user/month billed annually ($12.50 billed monthly). Calendar, Timeline, Table, Dashboard and Map views; unlimited command runs; admin and security features.
facts.evidenceNote: Free trial of Premium available per FAQ.

facts.factValue: Enterprise: $17.50 USD per user/month billed annually ($210.00 annual price per user).
200+ apps and tools via Power-Ups, e.g. Slack, Google Drive, Salesforce; some partner Power-Ups need an extra subscription.
SOC2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and PCI-DSS certified; cloud-only product.
Web (latest Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari), iOS and Android apps, desktop apps via the Mac App Store and Microsoft Store.

faq.question: Is Otter.ai free?
faq.answer: Yes. The Basic plan is free and includes 300 transcription minutes a month, up to 30 minutes per conversation and 3 audio/video file imports in total (checked on otter.ai/pricing, 5 Nov 2026).

faq.question: Which meeting apps does Otter.ai work with?
faq.answer: Otter's official site says it can join Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet meetings to take notes. It also offers Mac and Windows desktop apps that record without a bot joining the call.

faq.question: What languages does Otter.ai transcribe?
faq.answer: The pricing page lists AI transcription in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Chinese.

faq.question: Is Trello free?
faq.answer: Yes. The Free plan costs $0 and covers up to 10 collaborators and up to 10 boards per Workspace, with 250 automation command runs a month (checked on trello.com/pricing, 5 Nov 2026).

faq.question: How much does Trello Premium cost?
faq.answer: Premium is $10 USD per user per month billed annually, or $12.50 billed monthly. Trello's FAQ says any Workspace can start a free Premium trial.

faq.question: Does Trello have AI features?
faq.answer: Yes, on paid plans. The pricing page lists AI on Standard and Premium, including AI summarization, AI organization (checklists, due dates, merging cards) and AI-generated boards.
